name: postkeep.dev
description: The open-source postkeep website (postkeep.dev): home, docs, Cloud or self-host, and the 404 page.

scripts.dev: bun run docs && bun --bun astro dev
scripts.build: bun run docs && bun --bun astro build
scripts.check:types: bun run docs && bun --bun astro check && bun x tsc --noEmit -p .
scripts.check: bun run check:types && bun run build && bun test checks/facts.test.ts && bun run check:content && bun run check:dist
